name: parcels
description: Stage 3 private-parcel boundaries: GEOMETRY ONLY (apn/county/acres/st), no owner names or addresses ever. Phase 1 = clean-license statewide states per docs/research/2026-08-09-free-parcel-boundaries.md §6 (app repo).

parcels.apn: assessor parcel number / parcel ID (string), optional
parcels.county: county name or FIPS as published by the source (string), optional — some states publish FIPS only; client formats or omits
parcels.acres: source-published acreage rounded to 2 decimals (number), optional — NEVER computed from geometry in v1

schema.contract_note: This schema is the CONTRACT with the Android client (parcel identify sheet). It is also the QA WHITELIST: qa_parcels.py hard-fails the build if any other attribute key reaches the normalized output or a decoded tile. Owner names/addresses in tiles would convert a $0 layer into a vendor licensing negotiation — the whitelist gate is the enforcement point (research §5, §6 risk 4). It also neutralizes MT MCA 2-6-1017 and ID §74-120 mailing-list statutes.
schema.shards_note: Unit codes in sources.json are state codes, sharded states use ST_1/ST_2 (TX, FL); st = unit prefix. Shards split on FILE LISTS, never attribute where-clauses: TX by FIPS range over mirrored county zips, FL by size-balanced halves of the FDOR county-zip list (attribute filters against the FL AGOL service are unindexed/504-prone — see sources.json FL_1 notes).

sources: layers/parcels/sources.json — one entry per matrix unit: {mode: http|rest, urls, layer, fields{apn,county,acres}, where?, count_expected, notes}. Endpoints + field names live-verified 2026-08-09. License basis per state: app repo docs/research/2026-08-09-free-parcel-boundaries.md §2 — do not add a state that is not CONFIRMED/clean there without founder sign-off.

app_credits_screen: Utah: State of Utah, UGRC/SGID — CC BY 4.0 (link license, note changes)
Maryland: State of Maryland iMAP (metadata acknowledgment)
District of Columbia: Open Data DC (CC BY 4.0)
Indiana: Indiana GIS Data Harvest Program (citation requested)
All other Phase 1 states: state open-records parcel programs — see research doc §6 Phase 1 list

qa.attribute_whitelist: HARD GATE (qa_parcels.py): every feature in parcels.geojsonl AND in decoded sample tiles must carry ONLY keys ⊆ {apn, county, acres, st}. Any other key fails the build. This is the owner-names-never-in-tiles invariant.
qa.count: kept feature count within tolerance (default ±25%) of sources.json count_expected (vintages drift annually)
qa.size_calibration: KB/parcel printed per unit; expected 0.4-0.7 KB/parcel through the pyramid (research §5, calibrated vs lands). WARN outside 0.2-1.5 — the pilot (UT MT WI) validates the constant before the full matrix is trusted.

pilot: Per research §5 risk control: UT + MT + WI first (workflow_dispatch states subset, artifact-only), check KB/parcel constant, then full matrix.
phase2_backlog: WY (email out to DOR), CA bootstrap+overwrite, CO county set, AZ Pinal/Cochise, WA carve-out identification, NM Bernalillo, MS disclaimer PDF, AR wording — research §6 Phase 2.
